description: This PHP file defines a controller class `EmployeeTrackerLogsController` within a human resource management system. The class manages the rendering and access control logic for employee performance tracker logs, including loading performance tracker data and validating user permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerLogsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee performance tracker log views and access control within the HRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component with performance tracker data before rendering. It loads the tracker based on the request attribute and adds relevant properties to the component.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access the specified performance tracker, throwing an exception if not.
